subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about recovering the paying subscribers {Brand} has already earned and then lost. The one point worth repeating: across US streaming, 45% of cancellers resubscribe within twelve months, so the win-back pool is real and standing. We read the leak between paywall view, cancellation, and the resumed paid plan, then bring lapsed users back to a start that renews, reactivating roughly 2,000 paid subscriptions a day in an active program. Want me to pull the days-since-lapse cohort map for your titles?
angle: warm bump, restate resubscribe-pool + paywall-leak proof
illustrative_flags: 2,000 paid subscriptions a day (MobUpps, illustrative daily reactivation volume)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN/US subscription_media: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (45% resubscribe pool + paywall-to-paid recovery); one illustrative MobUpps figure (2,000/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native EN; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em-dash; brands reused from parent only.
